name: Swansea City Association Football Club
notes: Country corrected to Wales (the club plays in the English pyramid). Founded year is the Companies House incorporation date of the club company (25 July 1912). Revenue and pre-tax loss are from the club's own summary of its accounts for the year to 30 June 2025 (prior period was 11 months to 30 June 2024); the full group accounts on Companies House (04305508, filed 17 Apr 2026) are a scanned PDF with no text layer, so wages, operating result and net debt were not taken from them. Companies House PSC register (04305508) lists Brett Cravatt and Jason Cohen as persons with significant control since 22 November 2024; Andy Coleman ceased 30 May 2025 after stepping down as chairman (club statement 14 March 2025) and remains a co-investor; no successor chair is named on the club site. Stakes of Modrić, Snoop Dogg and Martha Stewart are not disclosed. Stadium sale agreed by the council in July 2026 but not completed as of the August 2026 CEO update. The CEO said unaudited 2025-26 revenues grew over 25% (no figure). No Forbes/Sportico valuation exists for the club; no follower counts with a dated source found.

ownership_summary: Swansea City AFC Ltd is wholly owned by Swansea City Football 2002 Limited, whose shareholders are Swansea Football LLC (controlled by US investors Brett Cravatt and Jason Cohen) with 82.73%, Nigel Morris with 10.29% and the Swansea City Supporters Society (the Supporters' Trust) with 6.44%. Cravatt, Cohen, Morris and Andy Coleman took control of the LLC from Steve Kaplan, Jason Levien and partners in November 2024; Luka Modric, Snoop Dogg and Martha Stewart joined as minority co-owners in 2025.
